notes: Added: Gun Game mode - every kill gives the next weapon, the last one is the sword; 17 new weapons (pistol, SMG, shotgun, sniper, rocket and grenade launcher, minigun, railgun, sword and more); bots know how to use every weapon | Fixed: switching camera while spectating a teammate no longer needs a click | Changed: Play vs Bots and the lobby keep the same size when you change the mode

added: First public build: 3D team shooter with cards, bots and online play
In-game updater with short patch notes
New map: Frost Yard (compact snowy arena)
Join accepts a host name, e.g. cardarena.tr1zoru.ro
fixed: Play vs Bots started a 3v3 when you chose 1v3
Settings window keeps the same size on every tab
No update server error before the first release

added: Join remembers your servers (recent list, no more 127.0.0.1 default)
Spectate a living teammate after you die
The game checks for updates by itself, no need to press Check
fixed: Changing a setting no longer shrinks a maximized window
changed: Homing is a subtle nudge toward enemies near your aim

added: Gun Game mode - every kill gives the next weapon, the last one is the sword
17 new weapons (pistol, SMG, shotgun, sniper, rocket and grenade launcher, minigun, railgun, sword and more)
bots know how to use every weapon
fixed: switching camera while spectating a teammate no longer needs a click
changed: Play vs Bots and the lobby keep the same size when you change the mode
